cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Your rooftop wedding photo would look lovely. Try that staff-only door first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm the bride. They'll notice me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. They'll forgive you. I'll follow once you've explained the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll hold the very end, so if they object, only your train has followed you in.
